title: FX Locks: lock delay and reverb from the track
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: Parameter locks on the shared delay and reverb, from the audio track itself: hold a trig and turn delay TIME (it steps through note values: 1/16, 1/8., 1/4 ...), WID or FDBK or reverb DEC on their pages, as for any lock. The step sets the delay/reverb when it plays and keeps it until the track's next trig, then the pattern's own value comes back. Two tracks locking the same knob at once: the higher track wins. The locks use sound slots 48-51, which no audio machine uses (not with machine-pages' extra-value machines). Needs seq-events.
